title: My Glowbook
sub: A public page with the creations you choose, to link from your Instagram bio. Your page and each creation are reviewed by the Global Toothgems team before anyone can see them.
unavailableBody: The Glowbook needs a signed-in Global Toothgems account.

page.pending: The team is reviewing your page. It will be visible at its address as soon as it is approved.
page.approved: Your page is live. It stays visible while your Studio access is active.
page.rejected: Your page was not approved. Edit it and save to send it for review again.

linkHint: Paste this link in your Instagram bio. It only shows once your page is approved.
deleteConfirm: Delete the page and take all your creations off it?

form.moderationNote: Your page will be visible once the Global Toothgems team approves it. After that, changes to the name, bio and Instagram are published at once.
form.handleHint: 3 to 30 characters: lower-case letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
form.handleChangeWarning: Changing your handle changes your page’s address and sends it for review again: it will not be visible until then.
form.bioPlaceholder: Your style, your city, how to book…

errors.handleLength: The handle must be 3 to {{max}} characters long.
errors.handleCharacters: Use only lower-case letters, digits, a dot, a hyphen or an underscore, and do not start or end with those signs.
errors.handleReserved: This handle is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.handleTaken: This handle is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.invalid: These details could not be accepted. Please check them.
errors.displayNameLength: The display name is 60 characters at most.
errors.bioLength: The bio is 300 characters at most.
errors.instagramInvalid: This Instagram account is not valid (letters, digits, dot and underscore, 30 characters at most).

items.howTo: To add one, open it in My Creations and choose “Add to my Glowbook”.
items.emptyBody: Open a creation in My Creations and add it to your Glowbook: it is published once approved.

control.title: My Glowbook
control.noGlowbook: Share your creations on a public page to link from your Instagram bio.
control.empty: Add at least one gem to publish it.
control.notIn: Add it to your public page. It will be visible once the team approves it.
control.pending: Waiting for the team’s review before it shows on your page.
control.approved: Visible on your public page. Your next saves are published there at once.

toasts.addedBody: It will appear in your Glowbook once approved.
toasts.full: Your Glowbook already holds 60 creations: remove one to add another.
toasts.linkCopiedBody: Paste it in your Instagram bio.
toasts.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link
toasts.lookSavedPending: Look saved: the new pictures and links wait for review
toasts.sectionsFull: Your Glowbook already has 12 sections: delete one to create another.

glowbookLive.title: This creation is public
glowbookLive.body: “{{name}}” is visible to everyone in your Glowbook. If you save, your changes are published there at once.

glowbookPending.title: This creation is about to be published
glowbookPending.body: “{{name}}” is being reviewed for your public Glowbook. The version you save is the one published once approved.

template.title: This template is shared with every artist
template.body: “{{name}}” is a published Global Toothgems template. If you save, every Studio member sees your changes at once.

public.metaDescription: Tooth gem creations by {{name}}, designed in the Global Toothgems 3D Studio.
public.empty: No creations published yet. Come back soon!
public.ctaBody: These creations were composed in the Global Toothgems 3D Studio. Try it, or discover our gems.

admin.title: Glowbook
admin.description: Artists’ public pages and the creations they add wait here for your approval. Nothing is visible before.
admin.unavailableBody: Glowbook moderation needs the live database.
admin.forbiddenBody: Glowbook moderation is for team members who moderate reviews.
admin.errorTitle: Unable to load the moderation queue
admin.errorBody: Please try again in a moment.
admin.emptyPendingBody: New pages and creations sent by artists will show here.
admin.emptyBody: Change the view or the search.
admin.notePlaceholder: e.g. render too dark, off-topic content…

toasts.rejected: Declined: the artist will see the reason
toasts.failed: The decision could not be saved

admin.proposedWithPage: Proposed with the page (published if you approve the page)

look.title: Customise my page
look.sub: Make your Glowbook yours: picture, colour, layout and links. Colour, background, layout, spotlight and city are published when you save; a new picture or link is reviewed by the team first.
look.pendingNote: Some pictures or links wait for the team’s review: your page shows the previous ones meanwhile.
look.rejectedNote: Your latest pictures or links were not approved.
look.rejectedNoteReason: Your latest pictures or links were not approved. Reason: {{note}}
look.featuredHint: It opens your page, large, in a short video moving in front of the smile from left to right (published creations only).
look.linksHint: https addresses only. Every new link is reviewed before it shows.

errors.locationLength: The city is {{max}} characters at most.
errors.bookingUrl: The booking link must be a valid https address.
errors.websiteUrl: The website must be a valid https address.
errors.tiktok: This TikTok account is not valid (letters, digits, dot and underscore).

look.avatarHint: Cropped square. JPEG, PNG or WebP.
look.bannerHint: Cropped to 3:1, shown at the top of the page. JPEG, PNG or WebP.

pictureErrors.type: This file is not a picture.
pictureErrors.tooLarge: Picture too large (20 MB at most).
pictureErrors.unreadable: This picture could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.

spotlight.title: Spotlight video
spotlight.saveFirst: Save the look: the video of this creation will be prepared next.
spotlight.preparing: Preparing the video… It is recorded right here, in your browser; your page shows the creation’s picture meanwhile.
spotlight.keepOpen: Keep this tab open and visible for a few seconds.

failed.unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Open the Studio in a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari to make it; your page shows the creation’s picture meanwhile.
failed.interrupted: The recording stopped (the tab was hidden). It starts again as soon as the tab is visible.
failed.failed: The video could not be recorded. Try again; your page shows the creation’s picture meanwhile.

spotlight.ready: Video live: the camera moves in front of the smile, left to right and back, on a loop.

sections.title: Sections of my page
sections.sub: Sort your creations by theme (“Wedding”, “Minimal”…). Visitors filter your page by section; creations without a section stay visible. A section only shows once it holds a published creation. Names are published when you save, like your bio.
sections.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its creations stay on your page, without a section.

errors.length: The name is {{max}} characters at most.
errors.taken: You already have a section with this name.
errors.full: 12 sections at most: delete one to create another.
errors.failed: The section could not be saved. Please try again.

badge.label: Global Toothgems certified artist
badge.title: “Certified artist” badge
badge.earned: You completed a Global Toothgems course with a certificate: your page can show it, with the course title.
badge.show: Show the badge on my page
badge.hiddenNote: The badge is hidden: visitors do not see it.
badge.notEarned: Complete a Global Toothgems Academy course that issues a certificate: a “certified artist” badge will appear on your page.

qr.title: QR code of my page
qr.sub: Print it for your studio: clients scan it and discover your creations.
qr.locked: The QR code will be available once your page is approved: until then its address does not open.
qr.hint: The poster shows your name, profile picture and colour. The QR code opens your page in {{language}}.
qr.footer: Creations designed in the Global Toothgems 3D Studio
